title: Use bulk calls for checking which entries are not in remote
description:
This uses the new `bulk_remote_exists` functionality introduced in https://github.com/treeverse/dvc-data/pull/637 for checking which entries are not present in the remote (e.g., during `dvc data status --not-in-remote`).

This is a draft for now until that PR in dvc-data is merged.
